rfq_details.title: Portable Power Distribution Cables and Accessories for Municipal Event Venue
rfq_details.project_name: Portable Power Distribution Cables and Accessories for Municipal Event Venue

introduction: We are requesting quotes for portable power distribution cables and accessories for a municipal client in Michigan. This equipment will be used for stage and event power distribution at a government venue. All items must meet professional theatrical/stage power standards and be suitable for outdoor event use.

scope_of_work.title: SCOPE OF WORK
scope_of_work.description: Supplier must provide complete pricing for all items listed below. Products must be new, unused, and meet or exceed the specifications provided. Delivery will be required to Metro Detroit area within 30 days of order placement. Supplier must be able to provide all items from a single source or coordinate with approved subcontractors.
key_requirements: All cables must be UL listed or equivalent certification
Socapex cables must use genuine SOCO-type 19-pin connectors
All electrical components must meet NEC requirements for stage power
Camlock connectors must be rated for 350-400 amp service
Cat6 cables must use Neutrik Ethercon connectors
Road cases must be ATA-rated or equivalent professional grade
All items must be suitable for outdoor/weather-resistant use
Products must be from established manufacturers with warranty support

submission_requirements.title: QUOTE SUBMISSION REQUIREMENTS
items: PRICING: Provide complete unit pricing for each line item with any volume discounts
MANUFACTURER INFO: Include manufacturer name and part number for each item
DELIVERY: Specify lead time in business days and confirm FOB terms (destination preferred)
SHIPPING: State whether freight is included in pricing or quote separately
QUOTE FORMAT: Respond via email with itemized pricing in Excel/PDF format
PAYMENT TERMS: State your standard payment terms (Net 30, Net 60, etc.)
QUOTE VALIDITY: Confirm how long pricing remains valid
CONTACT INFO: Include primary contact name, phone, and email for follow-up questions

items.title: Payment Terms
items.description: Net 30 days from invoice date. Purchase orders will be issued upon award.

items.title: Delivery Requirements
items.description: FOB Destination preferred (freight included in price). Specify lead times for each item.
